name: Monthly rotation across BTC, ETH and SOL

history.reason: Failed the scorecard (Luke, 2026-11-15). The note failed its scorecard and is rejected, but it is the only YouTube strategy that beat holding BTC over 2018-01 to 2025-10: Sharpe 1.13, 1.25 and 1.26 (365/180/90-day lookbacks) against 0.74. It fails the drawdown limit (-59%), luck (deflated 30-43%) and out of sample: it beat BTC in only 3 of 11 walk-forward windows, almost all of its lead coming from holding ETH and SOL in 2021. No further work without new evidence; a version with a drawdown control would be a new note with new trials.
